name: Jackpot Hunter

features.name: Trail game
features.description: Spin a wheel to move along a 41-space map.

review:
Jackpot Hunter is a 5x4, 20-line jungle adventure with backpacks, maps and dinosaurs. Compass wilds help form wins, and two bonuses are available: three wheel symbols trigger a trail game, while three Aztec scatters trigger free spins.

The trail game uses a 41-space map. You get five spins of a wheel numbered one to eight to move along it, collecting prizes as you go. Pragmatic Play advertises up to 5,000x. Note the RTP is 96%. The board-game style trail is a nice break from standard free spins.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
